run_live_denoiser: run the denoiser.live module to perform live speech enhancement from mic to output interface
run_get_parser: run the get_parser function to build an argparse parser for live denoiser CLI arguments
run_parse_audio_device: run the parse_audio_device function to convert a device string to an int or keep as name
run_query_devices: run the query_devices function to query sounddevice capabilities for an input or output interface
run_main: run the main function to start the live audio denoising loop with streaming input and output
